card.name: Harness Shop
card.description: Sells lamps, chairs and bookshelves. A model negotiates the price with the buyer.

skills.name: Negotiate a purchase
skills.description: Ask for an item (lamp, chair, bookshelf), then send offers as numbers. The shop answers with a counteroffer, a receipt, or a refusal.
examples: I want to buy a lamp

parts.text: I want to buy a lamp
